brief: Stands in for an HTTP service offline, answering from rules you script or answers you recorded, and journals every request.
detail: It follows the HTTP port contract: any object with Request(method, url, body) that returns a list with status, body and from. Scripted mode drives behaviour, with a rule per method and address pattern, first match winning. Replay mode keeps what a real service said, filed under a hash of method, address and body, and a recording wins over a rule. By default an unscripted, unrecorded request raises an error, because a double that silently answers makes a test pass for the wrong reason; SetStrict(0) answers 501 instead. Every request is journalled, so a test can check what the code tried to do. The state lives in a table shared by copies, so a copy of the sandbox sees the same rules.
